'''One''' of the [[Kagles]], a trio of furred [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], was distinguished from [[Gender/Legends|his]] fellows by the fact that he wore a [[Color/Legends]]blue shirt. The Kagle had brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and a shock of orange hair atop his head. He had light yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].
